fact_previews: NetWatcher is a creative application designed to provide surveillance over the Internet on specified computer and tablet devices.
NetWatcher monitors 50 devices, allowing remote monitoring of the surrounding environment if a video camera is attached.
NetWatcher originally emerged into the market in 2003 via NetGuarder and holds copyrights authorized by the National Copyright Administration of the People's Republic of China.
The original version of NetWatcher was limited to monitoring local network connected computers.
The newly designed NetWatcher makes a breakthrough in network boundary and integrates into modern life with network everywhere.

fact_previews: The project aims to collect money to develop a version of NetWatcher for the Android platform.
NetWatcher allows parents to observe and control their children's computer usage and internet surfing.
NetWatcher serves as a powerful deterrent for improving children's behaviors.
Families can connect extra video cameras to NetWatcher agent enabled devices to build a remote surveillance system.
NetWatcher is designed as a supervision solution for managers and technical people in enterprises.
